meta.title: Adding a draft stage to an already-live event publishes just that stage
gaps: The vocabulary does not provide the new draft stage's uuid as a token or a field path, so the update cannot be limited to only that stage.
The existing stage cannot be identified separately from the newly added stage for verification, so its status and bids are not independently confirmed.
The setup uses an event with an existing bid, but the vocabulary does not expose a token to distinguish the existing round's tradeId from the newly added round's tradeId.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event.
The buyer updates the event with the status set to “active”.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “status” equals active.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “bid count” equals 1.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “status” equals active; “bid count” equals 1.
